## S2J OSS Notice v0.0.1

Pre-release baseline (`@s2j/oss-notice` 0.0.1).

### Highlights

* Ack backend: SPDX / CycloneDX → `OSS_Notice_*.md` (onot-compatible CLI)
* lockfile 直通: Composer / npm / pnpm / yarn → `--out-file`
* Thin `init`, standalone `doctor`, `test:doctor` ONOT-DOC-001–008
* Spec docs 1.0.0-spec, Ack `pipeline.engine: "oss-notice"` integration

### Install

```bash
npm install -D @s2j/oss-notice
```

Full notes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/stein2nd/s2j-oss-notice/blob/v0.0.1/CHANGELOG.md).
